service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Beaver Creek
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Beaver Creek's village and on-mountain venues, solo through quartet.

faqs.q: How does gear reach Beano's Cabin or another on-mountain venue?
faqs.a: The way the venue runs its access: by sleigh, snowcat or gondola in winter, by vehicle in summer. We settle the route, the schedule and where cases wait with the venue in writing before the day, because those answers decide what gear we bring and when it travels.

faqs.q: How does load-in work in the village core?
faqs.a: By dock and service route, on a window the hotel schedules. The village core is pedestrian and terraced, and the escalators are for guests, so we plan the dock time and the distance to the floor with the venue in advance. Load-in runs 45 to 90 minutes depending on the size of the band.

faqs.q: What is the travel line for Beaver Creek?
faqs.a: Travel is its own line on the quote, the I-70 corridor drive from Denver, so the cost of reaching the village is visible before you commit to anything rather than after. A late curfew or a venue up the mountain can add a night's lodging, named at contract.

faqs.q: Is there a published noise cap in Beaver Creek?
faqs.a: We have not confirmed one, and our mountain corridor page says so. Each venue sets its own event rules, so send the venue name and we get the governing number in writing before the contract. For scale, dinner sets run 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table.

faqs.q: What size fits a retreat dinner here?
faqs.a: A duo or a trio at conversation volume carries dinner, and the quartet is the closing-night booking when filling a floor is the objective. Every size prices from the published resort column, and a multi-evening trip can sit on one contract.
